'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a NPC Artisan found at night scolding two workers playing with their [[Cloud Pack]] in [[Xuanfang Hold]], [[Mengzhou]] region. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
;(Daytime)
:'''Xingyuan:''' I win! I flew two centimeters higher than you! 
:'''Changhe:''' Impossible. It can't be...
:'''Changhe:''' Only I have mastered the secret technique of "Soaring to the Heavens"...
:'''Xingyuan:''' Hmph, while you were living it up, I havent' stopped training for a single moment.

;(Nighttime)
:'''Qingyuan:''' Multiple unauthorized Cloud Pack violations, disregard for safety standards...
:'''Qingyuan:''' Listen here, a Cloud Pack is for aerial work, not a toy for you to play with just because you're upset with each other.

==Dialogue==
:'''Qingyuan:''' Multiple unauthorized Cloud Pack violations, disregard for safety standards...

:'''Qingyuan:''' Listen here, a Cloud Pack is for aerial work, not a toy for you to play with just because you're upset with each other.

:'''Xingyuan:''' B-But... Master, we're sorry! It won't happen again. Ever. We'll write a guarantee!

:'''Qingyuan:''' I want your Cloud Packs handed in by the end of the day. Neither of you is touching them for the rest of the month.

:'''Changhe:''' No, Master! Just punish us by making us copy "The Development Compendium" instead!
{{Dialogue End}}
